address: 629 E. Central Blvd., Orlando, FL, 32801, USA
bio: Located in the Thornton Park neighborhood of Orlando, this stylish space offers plenty of charm. Chef Michael Cooper's Italian American menu delivers the classics (think chicken parm) albeit with some swagger. Start the meal with one of their delicious house-made breads like the gnocco fritto, an Italian fry bread, before tucking into truffle arancini in a rich fonduta sauce. Their house-made pastas are always a hit, as in the bucatini diabolo with its spicy garlic-forward sauce. Round out the meal with butterscotch budino, a classic caramel silky pudding finished with hazelnuts and whipped cream.
